pipeline_steps.technique: Generation of Cre-driver knock-in mouse lines (Gad65-cre, Pvalb-cre, Som-cre)

parameters.construct_design: IRES-Cre recombinase coding sequence inserted into the 3' UTR of the respective mouse genes via homologous targeting
parameters.es_cells: electroporated into hybrid C57BL/6-129/SV stem cells, colonies screened by PCR for correct integration
parameters.breeding: Som-cre and Pvalb-cre maintained as a mixed strain; Gad65-cre backcrossed to and maintained as C57BL/6
parameters.reporter_cross: loxP-STOP-loxP-tdTomato reporter line bred with Gad65-cre to express tdTomato in GABAergic cells

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: Cre-driver knock-in mouse lines

pipeline_steps.technique: Construction of viral constructs (ChR2-sfGFP and PSAML141F-GlyR, Cre-dependent and Cre-independent variants)

parameters.chr2_construct: codon-optimized ChR2(1-304, H134R) fused to superfolder GFP via a 10-amino-acid linker, cloned into an rAAV cassette with a human synapsin promoter, WPRE, and SV40 polyA
parameters.cre_dependent_variants: Cre-dependent rAAV(ChR2-sfGFP), rAAV(sfGFP), rAAV(tdTomato), and rAAV(PSAML141F-GlyR) built by cloning the coding sequences in inverted orientation relative to the promoter
parameters.serotypes: assembled with a modified helper-free system as serotype 2/1 (rAAV:ChR2-sfGFP) or serotype 2/7 (Cre-dependent constructs)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: packaged AAV constructs for optogenetic activation and chemogenetic silencing

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection into dorsal CA3 and CA1

parameters.delivery: thin glass pipettes (10-µm tip diameter) with Nanoject II injectors (Drummond Scientific), ~30 nl high-titer virus per injection along the pipette withdrawal tract
parameters.ca3_injection: rAAV:ChR2-sfGFP, 6 penetrations, 2 injections per penetration, bilateral dorsal CA3
parameters.ca1_injection: rAAV(PSAML141F-GlyR)Cre and rAAV(tdTomato)Cre at 3:1 ratio, 4 penetrations, 5-7 injections per penetration; a separate cohort received rAAV(ChR2-sfGFP)Cre alone in CA1 (3 penetrations, 5 injections per penetration)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice expressing ChR2-sfGFP in CA3 Schaffer collaterals and/or PSAML141F-GlyR in CA1 interneurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Acute hippocampal slice preparation and whole-cell patch-clamp recording from CA1 pyramidal neurons and interneurons

parameters.slicing: 350 µm coronal slices from adult dorsal hippocampus, secured on mesh in a custom double-perfusion chamber
parameters.acsf: 125 mM NaCl, 25 mM NaHCO3, 2.5 mM KCl, 1.25 mM NaH2PO4, 1 mM MgCl2, 2 mM CaCl2, 22.5 mM glucose, 3 mM sodium pyruvate, 1 mM ascorbate, saturated with 95% O2/5% CO2, perfused at 5-7 ml/min at 32-33°C; 500 nM CGP55845 added during most recordings
parameters.visualization: Dodt contrast optics on a Zeiss Examiner Z1, 40x (NA 0.75) for somatic and 63x (NA 1.0) for dendritic recordings
parameters.recording: Dagan BVC-700A amplifier in active bridge mode, filtered 1-10 kHz, digitized at 50 kHz; pipette resistances ~4-7 MΩ (somatic) and ~8-10 MΩ (dendritic)
parameters.internal_solution: 130 mM potassium gluconate, 8 mM KCl, 4 mM NaCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM MgATP, 0.3 mM TrisGTP, 14 mM phosphocreatine, 0.1 mM Alexa 594 or Alexa 488, pH 7.25; 0.2% biocytin added for interneuron recordings

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell electrophysiological recordings from CA1 pyramidal neurons and interneurons
pipeline_steps.hardware: Dagan BVC-700A amplifier; Zeiss Examiner Z1 microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Combined two-photon glutamate uncaging and single-photon GABA uncaging

parameters.glutamate_uncaging: PENB-l-caged glutamate (2 mM, applied via broken pipette above slice) photolyzed at 740 nm using a dual galvanometer-based scanning system (Prairie Technologies); Alexa 594/488 excited at 920-930 nm with an Ultra II Chameleon laser (Coherent)
parameters.spatial_pattern: asynchronous uncaging (100-ms ISI) onto up to 40 spines of well-isolated dendrites (<60 µm below slice surface) to evoke temporally isolated EPSPs, summed arithmetically and compared to the actually measured response
parameters.gaba_uncaging: single-photon uncaging of 80 or 160 µM Rubi-GABA via a 473 nm blue laser (CrystaLaser) coupled to the scan-head, placed near (<5 µm) the excited branch, near the soma, or in the apical tuft
parameters.combined_protocol: one-photon GABA uncaging followed by two-photon glutamate uncaging with a 1-5 ms ISI

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: EPSPs/EPSCs from combined glutamate and GABA uncaging at defined dendritic locations
pipeline_steps.hardware: dual galvanometer scanning system (Prairie Technologies); Chameleon Ultra II laser (Coherent); CrystaLaser 473 nm laser

pipeline_steps.technique: ChR2 photostimulation grid mapping of CA3 Schaffer collateral input

parameters.stimulation: 473 nm blue DPSS laser (CrystaLaser) coupled to the two-photon scan-head via a 20x objective, 1-ms pulses at 10-200 µW, timing/position/intensity controlled via PrairieView-TriggerSync
parameters.grid: 6x8-point stimulation grid over CA1 strata radiatum/oriens, each point stimulated once in random spatial order
parameters.protocol: 4-ms ISI for phasic photostimulation (current clamp) or 74-ms ISI for isolated EPSCs (voltage clamp, after adding 20 µM SR95531 to block GABA receptors)
parameters.paired_recording: interneuron recorded first, then a nearby (<50 µm) pyramidal cell recorded with the same grid order/position for direct comparison

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: photostimulation-evoked EPSCs/EPSPs and firing rates from CA1 pyramidal neurons and interneurons
pipeline_steps.hardware: CrystaLaser 473 nm DPSS laser; two-photon scan-head with 20x objective

pipeline_steps.technique: Pharmacogenetic silencing of PSAML141F-GlyR-expressing interneurons via PSEM308

parameters.drug_prep: PSEM308 dissolved in DMSO, stored in 100 mM aliquots, diluted in ACSF to 3 µM final concentration
parameters.application: bath-applied for 20-30 min for maximal effect
parameters.other_drugs: gabazine (20 µM), D,L-AP5 (100 µM), CGP55845A (500 nM), 4-aminopyridine (2 mM), WIN-55,212-2 (1 µM); DMSO kept below 0.005% final

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: silenced PSAML141F-GlyR-expressing interneuron population

pipeline_steps.technique: Immunocytochemistry and confocal imaging for knock-in mouse characterization and interneuron identification

parameters.cre_characterization: anti-Cre recombinase primary (1:200,000) with biotinylated secondary, ABC-Elite/DAB-nickel development for light microscopy
parameters.fluorescent_ic: primary antibodies to parvalbumin (1:300), somatostatin (1:100), or Cre (1:1,000), with Alexa 633-, DyLight 649-, or DyLight 488-conjugated secondaries
parameters.psam_glyr_detection: Alexa 647-conjugated alpha-bungarotoxin (1:3,000) to directly detect PSAML141F-GlyR, cross-validated against tdTomato co-expression
parameters.imaging: confocal stacks (25-35 slices, 1-µm optical thickness) acquired at 40x on a Leica DM6000 B, stitched across CA1 and collapsed to one z-plane; cell counting performed in ImageJ

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: quantified interneuron subtype density and marker co-expression

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-hoc identification and reconstruction of biocytin-filled interneurons

parameters.processing: biocytin-filled slices fixed, washed, cryoprotected, re-sectioned (50 µm), developed with avidin-biotin complex and DAB
parameters.somatostatin_costain: Alexa 594-streptavidin visualization of filled cells with somatostatin immunoreactivity detected via anti-SOM (1:100) and DyLight 649-conjugated secondary (n=10)
parameters.reconstruction: some recovered neurons reconstructed in Neurolucida

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: identified interneuron subtype and morphological reconstructions

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of viral labeling efficiency

parameters.metric: ratio of PSAML141F-GlyR-expressing interneuron density in CA1 layers to total interneuron density in the same layers
parameters.total_density_reference: Gad65-cre: Cre-dependent tdTomato reporter progeny (n=15); Som-cre/Pvalb-cre: somatostatin (n=8) and parvalbumin (n=6) immunocytochemistry

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: viral labeling efficiency estimates per Cre line

pipeline_steps.technique: Input-output curve fitting and gain/offset quantification

parameters.curve_fit: sigmoid fit of form base + max/(1 + exp(xhalf - x))/rate to firing-rate vs. input curves
parameters.gain_metric: change in slope calculated as (control slope - experimental slope)/control slope, from the peak of the first derivative of the sigmoid fit
parameters.offset_metric: input shift (Δoffset) determined from the xhalf of the sigmoid fit
parameters.epsc_summation: individual EPSCs from the 74-ms-ISI photostimulation grid summed off-line with a 4-ms ISI to produce suprathreshold input-output curves

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: photostimulation-evoked firing rates and EPSC amplitudes
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: input-output curve parameters (gain, offset)

pipeline_steps.technique: Relative input resistance change analysis in somatic and dendritic compartments

parameters.method: compared mean hyperpolarization from a -100 pA current injection alone vs. current injection paired with CA3SC photostimulation (<100 pA mean input level), with the synaptic-input-alone response subtracted from paired traces
parameters.spike_removal: action potentials blanked from 2 ms before to 5 ms after the peak and linearly interpolated
parameters.burst_duration: full width at half-maximum depolarization calculated across the first 100 ms of CA3SC photostimulation from filtered current-clamp recordings

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: current-clamp recordings with and without CA3SC photostimulation
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: relative input resistance change per compartment

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.tests: Student's t-test or ANOVA with Tukey's post hoc test for significance of difference
parameters.reporting: all data reported as mean ± s.e.m.

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection of rAAV1/2(Synapsin-GCaMP5) to the medial septum of Cre-dependent tdTomato reporter mice for cell-type-specific GCaMP5 expression in septal GABAergic neurons

parameters.mouse_lines: hemizygous Gad65-cre (n=6), Pvalb-cre (n=14), or Som-cre (n=6) x loxP-STOP-loxP-tdTomato reporter
parameters.coordinates: +1.00 and 0.75 AP, 0.0 ML, -4.0 to -3.0 DV, 0.2-mm steps, 30-50 nl each

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GCaMP5-expressing septal GABAergic neurons
pipeline_steps.source_quote: targeted rAAV1/2(Synapsin-GCaMP5) to neurons in the medial septum

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic hippocampal imaging window and head-post implantation over left dorsal CA1

parameters.cannula_window: stainless steel cannula (3-mm diameter, 1.5-mm height) fixed to 3-mm coverglass (64-0720, Warner) with UV-curable adhesive

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic optical access window over dorsal CA1

pipeline_steps.technique: Monosynaptic tracing of inputs to septo-hippocampal GABAergic neurons using Cre-dependent pseudotyped rabies virus in Gad65-cre mice

parameters.complementation_vector: rAAV(EF1a-histoneGFP-2A-rabiesG(CVS11*B19))Cre, chimeric glycoprotein (CVS-11 G gene, SAD-B19 cytosolic tail)
parameters.priming_complementation_ratio: 1:4, 13 nl each, same coordinates as injection
parameters.rabies_virus: rabies(dG-dsRed2, Addgene #32638), injected 2 weeks after priming/complementation, 15 nl

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: coronal brain sections for identification of presynaptic input neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Pharmaco-genetic silencing of Som+ hippocampo-septal-projecting GABAergic neurons via PSAML141F-GlyR expression and systemic PSEM89S agonist injection during in vivo imaging

parameters.viruses: rAAV7/2(Synapsin-PSAML141F-GlyR)Cre bilaterally to dorsal CA1; rAAV1/2(Synapsin-GCaMP5) to medial septum

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: in vivo imaging data under pharmacogenetically silenced vs. drug-free control conditions

pipeline_steps.technique: Multi-modal sensory stimulus presentation (tone, light, air puff) via a microcontroller-driven behavioral apparatus, synchronized with two-photon imaging
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized stimulus event traces
pipeline_steps.hardware: Arduino microcontroller; NI USB-6229 DAQPAD (National Instruments)

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed auditory trace fear conditioning using licking suppression as the fear measure, in water-restricted mice

parameters.unconditioned_stimulus: air puff, 200 ms, 5 stimuli at 1 Hz
parameters.conditioning_schedule: spaced sessions across two consecutive days
parameters.control: treadmill belt material changed every session to prevent context conditioning

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: licking suppression traces as a measure of conditioned fear

pipeline_steps.technique: Awake, head-fixed two-photon imaging sessions with habituation protocol prior to data collection

parameters.habituation_progression: up to 1 hr of head-fixation by 3rd-4th session

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: in vivo two-photon imaging sessions in awake, behaving mice

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-photon imaging under anesthesia (ketamine/xylazine or urethane) following awake imaging sessions

parameters.ketamine_xylazine: 60 mg/kg ketamine + 6 mg/kg xylazine intraperitoneal, n=9 experiments in 6 mice
parameters.anesthesia_depth_assessment: loss of withdrawal reflex to paw pinch

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: two-photon imaging data under anesthesia

pipeline_steps.technique: Local pharmacology: drug application to the hippocampal surface via a punctured plastic coverslip over the imaging cannula

parameters.drugs: baclofen (400 uM, Tocris); CGP52432 (30 uM, Tocris); tetrodotoxin (30 uM, Sigma)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: imaging data under local drug application vs. control

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic local field potential recording from dorsal CA1 via a tungsten microwire implanted beneath the imaging cannula coverslip, theta-filtered

parameters.electrode: formvar-coated tungsten microwire (California Fine Wire), 75 um diameter, 30 kOhm impedance
parameters.theta_filter: finite impulse response filter, Kaiser window, 4-8 Hz

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: theta-filtered LFP signal
pipeline_steps.hardware: DAM80 extracellular amplifier (World Precision Instruments); NIDAQ A/D converter (National Instruments)

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging anatomy and immunohistochemistry for Chat to confirm cell-type-specific GCaMP5 expression

parameters.secondary: avidin-conjugated Alexa 660 (1:300, Invitrogen) or DyLight 594 (Jackson ImmunoResearch)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal tile-stack images for GCaMP5/Chat colocalization assessment

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro whole-cell voltage-clamp recording from CA1 stratum oriens/alveus interneurons in acute hippocampal slices, with ChR2 photostimulation of septo-hippocampal axons

parameters.intracellular_solution: 138 mM potassium gluconate, 4 mM NaCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM Mg2ATP, 0.3 mM Tris2GTP, 14 mM phosphocreatine, 0.1 mM Alexa 594 (low Cl-)
parameters.chr2_photostimulation: blue DPSS laser (473 nm, CrystaLaser) coupled to the two-photon scan-head uncaging path, 60x objective

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell voltage-clamp recordings of light-evoked postsynaptic currents

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection and chronic hippocampal imaging window implantation for PVBC axonal bouton imaging

parameters.virus: rAAV serotype 1 (rep/cap 2/1), Synapsin-GCaMP5-Cre, into dorsal CA1 of PV-TOM mice
parameters.implant_timing: chronic hippocampal imaging window implanted over left dorsal CA1, 2 weeks post-injection

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PV-TOM mice with GCaMP5-expressing PV+ boutons and chronic imaging access

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of PV+ basket-cell axonal boutons, including functional imaging during behavior and anatomical bouton-density z-stack imaging under anesthesia

parameters.functional_full_field: 256x128 px, 1.6 ms dwell, 2000-2400 frames, 165x165 um FOV, 7.63 Hz
parameters.functional_bouton_roi: 82x82 um or 41x41 um FOV, 9.7 Hz or 10.2 Hz
parameters.anatomical_zstack: ketamine/xylazine anesthesia, 82x82 um FOV, 512x512 px, 6 ms dwell, 100 frames, 3-6 mm z-stacks, superficial and deep locations
parameters.synchronization: custom-designed hardware/software for behavioral readout synchronized with imaging data

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: functional GCaMP5 bouton imaging data and anatomical bouton-density z-stacks

pipeline_steps.technique: Zebrafish acute chemoconvulsant seizure induction via pentylenetetrazol (PTZ) bath application
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: zebrafish exhibiting spontaneous PTZ-induced seizures

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon volumetric calcium imaging of whole zebrafish brain during baseline and PTZ-induced seizure states, with atlas registration and NMF-based signal extraction

parameters.acquisition: 1.2x zoom (1.44 um/px), 15 z-planes (15 um spacing), 0.59 s/volume, 2500 volumes
parameters.protocol: 5 min baseline, then 15 mM PTZ bath application, 20 min continued imaging
parameters.registration: Z-Brain atlas Tg(elavl3:H2B-RFP) volume via Computational Morphometry Toolkit (CMTK)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single-cell functional calcium dynamics registered to a common brain atlas

pipeline_steps.technique: Mouse intrahippocampal kainic-acid model of chronic temporal lobe epilepsy: tamoxifen-induced adult-born granule cell labeling, kainic acid injection, viral GCaMP6f injection, chronic imaging window and LFP electrode implantation

parameters.tamoxifen: 3 mg IP/day for 5 consecutive days, 2 weeks before KA injection
parameters.ka_injection: kainic acid into ventral hippocampus to induce epilepsy
parameters.virus: rAAV(Syn-GCaMP6f) into dorsal dentate gyrus, ipsilateral to KA injection
parameters.implants: chronic imaging window over dorsal dentate gyrus; LFP electrode adjacent to KA injection site
parameters.monitoring: continuous video-EEG for ictogenesis, individually housed
parameters.imaging_start: 3 weeks post-KA injection, after video-EEG-verified TLE

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronically epileptic mice with dentate gyrus imaging/LFP access

pipeline_steps.technique: Concurrent two-photon calcium imaging of dentate gyrus granule cells and LFP recording in head-fixed epileptic and control mice

parameters.objective: 40x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3.5 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.control_data_source: healthy control recordings from Danielson et al. 2016, matched dentate gyrus location

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised calcium traces and concurrent LFP recordings

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic AAV injection strategy for cell-type-specific opsin/indicator expression and intersectional (Cre/Flp) targeting of SuM-projection circuits
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cell-type-specific opsin/indicator-expressing SuM or medial-septum neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Optical fiber implantation over SuM or ACC for in vivo optogenetic stimulation/inhibition
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic optical access for SuM or ACC photostimulation

pipeline_steps.technique: GRIN-lens implantation over SuM combined with contralateral CA1 LFP electrode placement guided by ripple-band monitoring

parameters.lens: 8.4 mm long, 0.5 mm diameter GRIN relay lens (Inscopix)
parameters.targeting: lowered while monitoring LFP for maximal ripple amplitude at stratum pyramidale

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic GRIN-lens imaging access to SuM with synchronized contralateral CA1 LFP

pipeline_steps.technique: Anterograde transsynaptic tracing of SuM-Tac1+ postsynaptic targets in the PAG using an intersectional AAV1-Cre-On-Flp strategy

parameters.pag_injection: 300 nL FlpON-ChR2-eYFP or FlpON-GCaMP6f, -4.5P, 0.4L, -3V relative to bregma

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: labeled postsynaptic PAG neurons receiving SuM-Tac1+ input

pipeline_steps.technique: Hippocampal (dentate gyrus or CA2) imaging window and headpost implantation with a contralateral 4-channel LFP electrode for sharp-wave-ripple monitoring

parameters.dg_window: 2.0 mm diameter, 2.3 mm height, implanted 100-200 um above the hippocampal fissure
parameters.analgesia: Metacam 5 mg/kg IP, bupivacaine 2 mg/kg SC
parameters.lfp_electrode: 4-channel bundled 51 um PFA-coated tungsten wire, contralateral CA1, 45 degree angle

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic hippocampal imaging window with synchronized contralateral LFP

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed treadmill/floating-ball locomotion tracking synchronized to imaging and electrophysiology

parameters.treadmill: quadrature rotary encoder on wheel axle, analog-to-digital converter, synchronized to imaging frames
parameters.ball_tracking: video camera at 60 fps, FFT-based frame-to-frame image registration for displacement/speed

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized locomotor speed traces

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo multichannel electrophysiological recording from hippocampus (CA1/dentate gyrus) combined with optogenetic stimulation (ChR2/stGtACR2/halorhodopsin) of SuM-Tac1+ or SuM-Tac1- circuits in head-fixed mice

parameters.probes: 32-channel linear probe (A1x32-6mm-50-177) or higher-density probe (A1x32-Poly3-10mm-50-177, Buzsaki32-CM32), Neuronexus
parameters.laser: 473 nm or 589 nm, 3-5 mW at fiber tip

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sorted single-unit spike trains and LFP with optogenetic-timing labels
pipeline_steps.hardware: Neuronexus silicon probes; Intan acquisition system; Shanghai Laser sources

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro acute-slice whole-cell patch-clamp recording from supramammillary neurons with optogenetic (ChR2) identification of Tac1+ versus Tac1- cell identity

parameters.protective_recovery_solution: NMDG-based, per Ting et al. protocol
parameters.recording_acsf: 126 mM NaCl, 26 mM NaHCO3, 10 mM glucose, 2.5 mM KCl, 2 mM MgCl2, 2 mM CaCl2, 1.25 mM NaH2PO4
parameters.internal_solution: 126 mM K-gluconate, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM KCl, 4 mM ATP-Mg, 0.3 mM GTP-Na, 10 mM phosphocreatine, 0.2% biocytin
parameters.amplifier: MultiClamp 700B, low-pass filtered 2 kHz, digitized at 10 kHz (Digidata 1440A)
parameters.optogenetic_id: 50 ms pulses of 465+/-15 nm illumination (DG-4 arc lamp), success/latency criteria to classify direct ChR2 responses

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell current-clamp recordings with optogenetically confirmed cell-type identity

pipeline_steps.technique: Post hoc immunohistochemistry for GFP/eYFP and VGAT with confocal imaging and fluorescence-intensity profiling across the dentate granule cell layer

parameters.primary_antibodies: anti-GFP (1:2000, Aves GFP-1020), anti-VGAT (1:2000, Synaptic Systems 131 011)
parameters.quantification: Plot Profile average fluorescence intensity across granule cell layer, two AP levels

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal images and granule-cell-layer fluorescence intensity profiles

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging of SuM and hippocampal (DG/CA2) neurons and axons during head-fixed locomotion, and larval zebrafish tail-vigor behavioral imaging, each with synchronized LFP or behavioral recording

parameters.sum_imaging: Neurolabware 2-photon microscope, 16x objective, 15.49 fps, 920 nm excitation, contralateral CA1 LFP amplified 1000x at 10 kHz
parameters.hippocampus_imaging: Bruker 8 kHz resonant scanner, 920 nm (Chameleon Ultra II), 512x512 px, 4x zoom, 210x210 um FOV, 30 Hz, synchronized 25 kHz LFP (Intan)
parameters.zebrafish_behavior: optomotor drifting-stripe stimuli at 60 Hz, tail movement filmed at 60 fps, Stytra-coordinated stimulus/behavior acquisition

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon calcium time series and synchronized LFP/behavior; zebrafish tail-vigor traces
